:::{#exm-rate-ratio-patterns}
#### Rate ratio for smoking

In @exm-poisson-reg,
smokers ($x_1 = 1$) have hospitalization rate $0.003$ per person-year
and non-smokers ($x_1 = 0$) have rate $0.002$ per person-year,
so by @def-rate-ratio-patterns:

$$
\ba
\rateratio(x_1 = 1 : x_1 = 0)
&= \frac{\lambda(x_1 = 1)}{\lambda(x_1 = 0)}
&& \text{(definition of rate ratio)} \\
&= \frac{0.003}{0.002}
&& \text{(substitute the two rates)} \\
&= 1.5
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$

Smokers are hospitalized at 1.5 times the rate of non-smokers.

:::
